fact_text: As of 4 Jan 2024 the KSE-100 trades at a price-earnings multiple of about 4.6 to 4.7 on expected earnings, which the analyst calls not yet price-discovered.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst said the 15 to 20 companies in a brokerage research universe still trade at forward or leading P/E multiples of about 3x.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst compared the Sensex 30 of India, at a P/E of about 25x to 26x, with Pakistan's much lower multiples.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst cited the Dow Jones in the US at a P/E of about 29 to 30, against the low multiples in Pakistan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst said Adani Group companies in India trade at P/E multiples above 100x, a level where he says price discovery does happen.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst argues Pakistan lacks price discovery because investor confidence is lower than in India, and P/E or enterprise value is calculated for fewer companies here.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: Foreign investors were net buyers over roughly the two to three months to 4 Jan 2024, which the analyst welcomed as a sign of rising outside interest.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: On an enterprise-value basis Pakistan cement makers look very cheap against Indian peers such as Ambuja, Shree Cement and Ram Cement, which the analyst puts down to weak price discovery.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: Urea and related fertilizer prices were raised in early January 2024 during election season, lifting shares of Fauji Fertilizer (FFC) and Engro Fertilizers (EFERT).
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)

fact_text: The analyst says fertilizer prices are very sensitive in Pakistan because 65 to 70 percent of the population lives in villages and rural areas.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Price Discovery Market Impact Stock Market Updates' (YouTube, 2024-01-04)
